description: Who fetched a site's pages in the last 28 days against the 28 before, counted by the site's own server: people, people an assistant such as ChatGPT or Perplexity sent, and crawlers by name, AI crawlers marked. By day, by crawler, by assistant and by page, with the last day an AI crawler fetched each page. A crawler fetching a page is not a citation, and a crawler is as it named itself. Only sites whose server sends counts to mttr have any; "connected" says whether the site has a key. Paths come under "quoted".
